relations.rationale: Leo stretching and chatting is unrelated to whether someone handed out flyers.
Leo stretching near the fence has no bearing on Hugo's height relative to Leo.
Leo stretching and chatting does not bear on whether Leo towered over the group.
Leo stretching before the run is a separate event from the runners setting off together, though both occur at the event, they don't imply each other.
Leo stretching near the fence does not imply anything about the sound of runners' shoes.
Dara arriving before Leo has no connection to whether Hugo booked the hall.
